english.title: Use on a road a wheeled goods vehicle / trailer with a rear under-run protective device not maintained
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled goods vehicle, namely

(A)_[a motor vehicle, **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) the weight of which exceeded 3500 kg]_
(B)_[a trailer the weight of which exceeded 1020 kg]_

when the rear under-run protective device fitted to that

(C)_[vehicle]_
(D)_[trailer]_

was not properly maintained in that **(..SPECIFY THE DEFECT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 50 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
